row.title: Test number must not match a live measurement
row.body: The no-made-up-numbers test used 47 percent. A live measurement now sits within the gate's tolerance of it, so the gate passed it and main went red. Fixed: the test uses 7919 percent, a value no ledger holds. Evidence: test_research passes, 17 of 17.
